intro:
Sanand has transformed over the last two decades from a quiet farming town into Ahmedabad's auto-industry satellite, home to major manufacturing plants and the workforce that's moved in around them. That mix of old agricultural families and newer working residents shows up at weddings too, where a big, well-produced baraat entry has become something of a local standard, loud and unmistakably festive.

Plan My Baraat brings the whole entry together for Sanand weddings as one booking: the double decker Baraat on Wheels truck, a dhol team, a vintage car or baggi for the groom's arrival, and the My Safa team turban-styling him and the full baraati group before the walk begins.
localArea:
Sanand sits west of Ahmedabad city, connected by wide, well-built roads that were largely developed alongside the industrial estates here, which makes truck access across most of the town genuinely easy. Venues near the older town centre have narrower approaches, so we plan those routes with a bit more care and confirm parking well ahead of time.

We cover Sanand regularly as part of our Ahmedabad-belt service area, and we're used to the range of venues here, from banquet halls serving the newer residential developments to more traditional wedding spaces closer to the original town centre and its market.
whatsIncluded:
Every package includes the DJ truck, sound system, and a DJ artist keeping the crowd energised as the baraat moves. Raj Tilak comes with 2 dhol and chhatri lighting. Rajwada steps up to 4 dhol and adds a teddy or gorilla performer alongside the truck. Maharaja, the package most Sanand families choose, brings moving LED panels and lights up the groom's name for the arrival. Signature, our top package, adds a security team, timed pyro and confetti, and an upgraded American vintage car.

The vintage car or baggi and the My Safa turban team are included in every package from Raj Tilak upward, so even the entry-level booking gives you a proper, complete arrival.
whyUs:
We're a Gujarat-based baraat planning team covering the wider Ahmedabad belt regularly, and Sanand is a town our crews know well, from the industrial-side approach roads to the specific venues families use most often for weddings here.

With one team handling the truck, dhol, car, and safa, you avoid coordinating four separate vendors yourself during the final busy week. We manage the timing so the truck's arrival, the dhol beat, and the groom's step out of the vintage car all land together at your Sanand venue.
pricingGuidance:
Pricing for a Sanand baraat depends on your package, dhol count, and any added effects like pyro or confetti. Raj Tilak is the most affordable way to get the complete core setup; Signature costs more because it's a genuinely bigger production, with more dhol, LED visuals, a security team, and the premium American vintage car.

Send us your date, your venue or area in Sanand, and a rough guest count, and we'll respond on WhatsApp with a real quote, usually within the hour, built around your actual event.
planningNotes:
Wedding season runs November to February, and Sanand tends to be somewhat busier than smaller towns given its size and proximity to Ahmedabad, so 2 to 3 weeks' notice in peak season is a sensible minimum. Outside that window, a week's notice generally works fine for us to plan around.

A rough headcount for the baraati group helps us plan dhol positioning and how much room the truck needs, particularly for venues in Sanand's newer, denser residential areas near the plants.
closing: Message us on WhatsApp with your wedding date, your venue in Sanand, and an approximate baraati headcount, and we'll confirm the truck's availability along with a package recommendation, usually within the hour.
